# Color harmony palette

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/palette-generator/

Create a small palette using complementary, analogous or triadic hue relationships. Preview the swatches and copy HEX values or CSS variables.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Start with your brand color and generate three related hues for a design exploration.

## Limits and checks

Hue relationships are a starting point, not a guarantee of readable text. Check important foreground and background pairs for contrast.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
